channel.title: Business Insider Nederland - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Business Insider Nederland (businessinsider.nl)

item.title: Expedia laid off some employees and promoted new job openings
item.description: Expedia cuts jobs to simplify its structure and focus on future skills. Employees share experiences and new job openings on LinkedIn.

item.title: See the aftermath of the massive winter storm that pummeled the US
item.description: The major winter storm blanketed dozens of US states over the weekend, impacting some 180 million people from the Southwest to New England.

item.title: Hundreds of Target employees urge the company to keep ICE out of stores. Read the letter to leadership.
item.description: More than 275 employees signed a letter to Target leadership that outlined four steps they say the company should take in response to ICE.

item.title: Sam Altman said OpenAI is planning to 'dramatically slow down' its pace of hiring
item.description: The OpenAI CEO said during a town hall event that OpenAI will "hire more slowly but keep hiring" because AI lets the company do more with less people.

item.title: Gabrielle Union, 53, says menopause made her rethink how she looks at life
item.description: Gabrielle Union said she eventually learned to view menopause "not as an ending, but as a beginning."

item.title: I spent years trying to blend in after moving to France. 10 years later, I've realized I don't have to.
item.description: Vivienne Zhao, 33, moved to Paris in her 20s. Living in France, far away from her parents, has shifted her understanding of home.

item.title: 'Absolutely shameful': Business and tech leaders react to Saturday's fatal immigration shooting
item.description: The killing of Alex Pretti, a US citizen, by Border Patrol in Minneapolis on Saturday has drawn sharp responses from business leaders.

item.title: 7 of the most interesting quotes from Anthropic CEO's sprawling 19,000-word essay about AI
item.description: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei wrote that AI poses "a serious civilizational challenge," one that will require society to take significant action.

item.title: Ukraine's new 35-year-old defense minister made 2 influential Telegram bloggers his advisors for drone warfare
item.description: In a major shift for Ukraine's military, Serhii "Flash" Beskrestnov and Serhii Sternenko are now officially advising Kyiv on defense tech and drones.

item.title: Why Starbucks is letting Brian Niccol use the company plane for more personal travel
item.description: Starbucks is having its CEO fly its private jet for all his travel — work and personal — and has removed his annual $250,000 travel budget cap.
